name: get_current_time
description: Get current time in a specific timezone

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Optional: defaults to the server's local timezone, 'America/New_York', when omitted.
timezone.title: Timezone

source_timezone.description: Source IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Optional: defaults to the server's local timezone, 'America/New_York', when omitted.
source_timezone.title: Source Timezone

target_timezone.description: Target IANA timezone name (e.g., 'Asia/Tokyo', 'America/San_Francisco'). Optional: defaults to the server's local timezone, 'America/New_York', when omitted.
target_timezone.title: Target Timezone

name: get_time_ago
description: Get the time a given number of days, hours, minutes and seconds ago in a specific timezone

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Optional: defaults to the server's local timezone, 'America/New_York', when omitted.
timezone.title: Timezone
